title: The Causal Grammar of Structured Coexistence: Conflict, Violence, Repair, and Non-Suppressive Peace
note: Preprint, 9 March 2026, 5 pages. Read in full via pdftotext (plain and -layout). This is a purely qualitative/sociological theory paper: it contains no numbered or boxed mathematical equations, no lettered propositions/lemmas (no CE-/P-/H-style labels), and no non-collapse 'X ≠ Y' formulas. Its only formal apparatus is prose definitions (structure as organized possibility; conflict as incompatible coexistence; violence as possibility compression; repair as protected reopening; peace as non-suppressive stability), one causal diagram (Figure 1: Structure -> Compatible/Incompatible Coexistence -> Violence -> Repair -> Peace), and one qualitative typology table (Table 1: Regimes of structured coexistence -- Tension/Conflict/Violence/Pseudo-peace/Peace by Compatibility x Possibility Space x Repair).
